states.name: load coffee capsule
states.definition: Retrieving and inserting the coffee capsule into the machine and operating the water tank and machine mechanisms.

states.name: brew coffee
states.definition: Pressing the button on the coffee machine to start the brewing process.

states.name: froth milk
states.definition: Opening the fridge, retrieving the milk bottle, pouring milk into the frother, and operating the milk frother.

states.name: mix coffee
states.definition: Adding the frothed milk to the coffee, stirring with a wooden stirrer, washing equipment, and discarding waste.
